description: Tender for Supply of Metformin Tablets BP 500mg 430,000,000 tablets
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-12-19
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to award the above tender to the lowest responsive bidder at a total cost of US $1,470,600.00 (LKR 192,598,118.00), was approved by the Cabinet.
